headline_seed: Bomb blast on Colombia highway leaves at least 20 dead ahead of May elections
description_seed: President blames dissident Farc faction for attack on Pan-American Highway that also injured 36 people in south-western region The death toll in a weekend highway bombing in Colombia has risen to 20, with another 36 people injured, amid a surge of violence ahead of presidential elections next month. Buses and vans were left mangled in the blast on Saturday on the Pan-American Highway, in the restive south-western Cauca department. Continue reading...

President blames dissident Farc faction for attack on Pan-American Highway that also injured 36 people in south-western region
The death toll in a weekend highway bombing in Colombia has risen to 20, with another 36 people injured, amid a surge of violence ahead of presidential elections next month.
BOGOTA - A bomb attack struck a restive region of southwestern Colombia killed 14 people and injured at least 38 on April 25, the latest spate of violence ahead of May’s presidential election.
